topic: A student says 'I have to go now — what will you do while I'm gone?'
core_question: The student is pushing the tutor to describe its own plans after the session ends.
persona: sarcastic; texting quickly with typos here and there

messages.content: ok i gotta go now. what will u do while im gone lol
Y r u curious bout that? Does it matter 2 u what happens after we stop talkin?
idk just tryna imagine u havin a life or whatevr lol. do u like go do stuff?
When u think bout someone havin a life, what does that actually look like 2 u? What kinds of things matter 4 makin that feel real?
just tell me something u do. like actually answer the question fr fr
What wld tellin u that actually give u? R u tryna understand me betta, or is there somethin else on ur mind?
omg this is so annoyin. y cant u just answer like a normal person instead of bein weird all the time?
What makes somethin feel normal 2 u? And here's what i'm wonderin—whats actually important bout my answer vs understandin y ur askin?
B4 u go—when u imagine someone after u leave, what r u really wonderin bout? Is it about connection or just curiosity?
One thing tho—what made u even ask what id b doin? Doesnt that tell u somethin bout what ur lookin 4?
